title: Generic webhook sources, registered in .tick/config.md
description:
The general case behind the two specific ones: a repository declares its own signal sources in .tick/config.md, and the Worker accepts webhooks for them.

Do this AFTER GitHub ingestion deliberately — the concrete source teaches what the generic registration actually needs, and the epic has already paid once this year for a config surface designed before its first consumer existed.

Each registered source needs a shared secret or signature scheme, a mapping from payload to draft-tick fields, and its own external_ref expression for dedup. Reuse the funnel's dedup rather than adding a second one.

.tick/config.md is the runner-neutral contract file, so its schema rules apply: unknown keys fail closed, and the parser builds tables with Object.create(null) (the __proto__ lesson is already in learnings).

ORCHESTRATOR DECISION on the thing the worker flagged: .tick/runners.toml is the RIGHT home, not .tick/config.md, and the worker was right to overrule my tick text. The repo's own recorded rule from epic 48d/tick 79x is 'a program-parsed, fail-closed surface needs a schema; config.md is prose', and config.md has had no machine-parsed sections since that epic. A webhook source declaration carries a signature scheme and a secret binding name — exactly the thing that must not live in prose. I wrote 'config.md' in the tick from the epic's original scope note; the scope note predates 48d.

Also: this tick needed a second pass. la9 landed in parallel and changed the funnel's success outcome from 'created' (with a tick_id) to 'drafted' (with a draft_id), because a signal no longer becomes a tick on arrival — a human accepts it first. The integrated gate caught it as 6 tsc errors and 4 test failures; neither worker could have seen it alone.
acceptance_criteria: A repo can declare a webhook source in .tick/config.md and have its payloads become draft ticks; an unsigned or wrongly-signed payload is refused; an unknown key in the source declaration fails closed; dedup is the funnel's, not a second implementation.
closed_reason: Completed: a repository declares its own webhook sources in .tick/runners.toml (schema-validated, fail-closed on unknown keys) and their payloads become draft ticks through the funnel. Reuses what vuz established rather than a weaker version: HMAC over the raw body verified before parsing, 503-and-ingest-nothing when unconfigured, 2xx for every settled outcome so a refusal cannot become a redelivery loop. Dedup is the funnel's.
